candidate_workaround: Insert the exact repository root at the front of sys.path before loading named unittest modules, then prove discovery count without executing the aggregate.
failure_signature: The first exact-final aggregate launched from the scripts directory, could not import the tests package, ran eight loader-error placeholders, and received zero successful-pass credit.
recurrence_guard: Every direct Python validation runner that loads repository modules must prepend its resolved repository root before unittest discovery.
rollback: Give the failed aggregate zero pass credit, preserve its external receipt, and use only the authorized fourth correction commit before any new aggregate attempt.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded Python import-path recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, privacy-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Bind direct unittest loading to the exact repository root
trigger_preconditions: A direct validation script reports tests package import failures because its script directory replaced the repository root on sys.path.
